author: Hermes
question: According to the official GATE 2027 important dates, on which dates are the GATE 2027 examinations held?
solution: The official important-dates page lists GATE 2027 examinations on 6, 7, 13, 14, 20 and 21 February 2027 (Saturday/Sunday pairs), with results on 19 March 2027. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/important_dates
subject: Exam schedule
